source_text: Ad moralem locum: habes et tu vitulum — carnem superbum. Si munus Domino offerre vis, adduc ad ostium tabernaculi — auditum divinorum librorum. Masculinum sit munus; impone manum et iugula contra Dominum — continentiae frenum, macero corpus meum. Filii Aaron in te — mens et sensus — offerant sanguinem. Hostiam vivam, sanctam, placentem Deo. Completur Homilia I. Amen.
pass_a_gloss: To moral place: you-have also you calf — flesh proud. If gift to-Lord to-offer you-wish, lead to door of-tabernacle — hearing of-divine books. Male let-it-be gift; place hand and slaughter against Lord — of-continence bridle, I-subdue body my. Sons of-Aaron in you — mind and sense — let-them-offer blood. Victim living, holy, pleasing to-God. Is-completed Homilia I. Amen.
pass_b_english: Turn the figure to morals: you too have a [[calf >> Bible:Leviticus 1:3]] — proud flesh. If you would offer it to the Lord, bring it to the door of the tent — to the hearing of the divine books. Let the gift be male; lay on your hand and slaughter it before the Lord — the bridle of continence, as Paul: [[I pommel my body and subdue it >> Bible:1 Corinthians 9:27]]. Aaron’s sons in you — mind and sense — present the blood. Offer a [[living sacrifice, holy, pleasing to God; your rational worship >> Bible:Romans 12:1]]. Homilia I CLOSEOUT. Amen.
